messages:
jordan: FYI PR #8401 is causing a noticeable perf delta in our production-like harness. attaching bench artifacts — can we gate this before merge?

jordan: summary from the latest run (prod-like, 8k seq, 48-gpu shard):
```
baseline (main): p50=28ms p95=95ms throughput=230 req/s mem=7.3GB
PR #8401:        p50=29ms p95=105ms throughput=216 req/s mem=7.5GB
delta: +10ms p95 (~10.5%), -6% throughput, +200MB mem
```

jordan: link: https://ci.internal/redwood/bench/8401-artifacts (logs + heatmaps). looking for 2 approvals but holding merge until perf sign-off + canary plan.

marta: acked. can you paste the exact commit that caused the shift? I can try bisecting locally.

jordan: it's the reshuffle of KV-shard hashing + new prefetch patch in the same PR — commit a1b2c3d is the prefetch change. bisect points there as the most likely.

ravi: thanks. quick question — is this only on longseq profile? any short-batch regressions?

jordan: short-batch (<=512 tokens) p95 is flat. regression shows up on 4k-8k sequences and during sustained concurrent sessions (prefetch interplay with tiling).

kevin: can we run a micro-canary (10% traffic) with the PR on a spare pool? If we see same delta on real traffic we can decide rollback vs revert.

jordan: I queued a canary run but CI flagged an alloc flake earlier, so I didn't promote. Asking for help to get a clean canary window.

ci-bot: Build #2875 for PR 8401 completed — artifacts uploaded. perf-run job failed on shard 7 due to transient gRPC timeout (logs in artifacts).

marta: I can take the bisect. if commit a1b2c3d reproduces locally, I can try toggling the prefetch config to confirm.

ravi: from SRE side: if we hold merge, we should schedule a canary window outside peak hours. ops suggests a 4-hour window late Sat or early Sun (low traffic) or an overnight Mon to Tue. also need oncall sign-off.

oncall: looping in @oncall for availability — weekend windows are okay but we prefer Mon 02:00-06:00 UTC for longer monitoring retention.

kevin: I can cover Mon 02:00-06:00 UTC. that gives time to rollback + roll forward if needed.

jordan: plan proposal: hold merge, require 2 approvals (eng-runtime + perf owner), SRE sign-off, and a 24-hour canary (Mon 02:00 UTC start, low % -> 50% ramp over 1h). if regression confirmed, revert commit a1b2c3d and re-run canary.

marta: +1 to hold. i'll priority-bisect today and post findings. probably a config toggle is enough to mitigate.

ravi: SRE +1 to the plan. please add the canary config to the PR (traffic split, rollback path, alert thresholds) before scheduling.

jordan: added canary config to PR branch, noted rollback steps in PR description. pinging reviewers: @marta @kevin — need your approvals once bisect + quick mitigations checked.

kevin: will review the canary config and give eyes tonight. if all green, i will approve but keep merge gated until after the Mon canary kickoff. :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks — I'll wait for the bisect result and then request final approvals. marking this thread HOLD for merge-window coordination.

ops-bot: Reminder: create incident channel if canary crosses alert thresholds. templates: #inc-canary-templates.

marta: bisect update: locally toggling prefetch off removes the p95 bump — looks like prefetch interactions with large KV hot lists. trying a smaller batch window to see tradeoffs. will post numbers in a follow-up.

jordan: perfect, appreciate it. once you paste the numbers i'll attach to the PR as mitigation notes.

kevin: noted. i'll keep an eye on the canary dashboard Monday.

jordan: final ask: please don't merge until i post "canary: green" or "canary: revert". thanks everyone.
